entities.summary: The Bondarikha culture or Bondarikhinskaya culture was a Late Bronze Age culture that occupied territories on both sides of the modern Ukraine-Russia border, replacing the Srubnaya culture. It was found from the left shore of the Dnepr to the upper and mid Seversky Donets, and it the east it reached the Don bassin and mid-Oka.
